title: Classify (CV)
description: Build a grouped, leakage-audited image classifier from real c1 negative-control and c2 positive-control cell crops.
objectives: Map the first two plate columns to negative and positive image classes.
Review dataset, architecture, optimization, validation, evaluation, inference, and runtime settings.
Understand grouped cross-validation, hyperparameter search, training, testing, and full-dataset inference.
prerequisite: Complete Measure so the project contains cell crops and measurements.db; define biologically valid control wells before training.
